tools.name: list_workflow_automation_skill_files
tools.title: List Workflow Automation Skill Files
tools.description: List the files in the platform 'workflow-automation' skill, the platform's guidance for authoring, changing, running, and troubleshooting a SEMOSS Automation workflow. Call this whenever an automation, workflow, scheduled job, or automation node is involved - adding or editing a step, wiring a decision branch, writing a node's Python, declaring trigger inputs or setup Python, or interpreting a save-time validation error. Covers the automation project MCP (GetAutomation, GetAutomationNodeDefinitions, AddAutomationStep, UpdateAutomationStep, UpdateAutomationCustomStep, RemoveAutomationStep, TriggerAutomation), the run(scope) contract every node's Python must satisfy, the read-only scope mapping, output-variable rules, and the per-node-type constraints the validator enforces. Returns each file with its path, name, and description so you can read only what you need; start with SKILL.md.

project.title: project
project.description: The workflow-automation skill (workflow-automation). Always this value.

tools.name: read_workflow_automation_skill_file
tools.title: Read Workflow Automation Skill File
tools.description: Read one file from the platform 'workflow-automation' skill in full, for authoring or troubleshooting a SEMOSS Automation workflow. Pass filePath exactly as list_workflow_automation_skill_files reports it; SKILL.md is the main guide and covers the authoring sequence, the run(scope) contract, the scope mapping and where ${...} is and is not resolved, output-variable rules, graph and branch wiring, the constraints on each node type, trigger inputs and setup Python, and safe custom-source edits with expectedSourceHash.

project.title: project
project.description: The workflow-automation skill (workflow-automation). Always this value.

filePath.title: filePath
filePath.description: Path of the file to read, relative to the skill folder, as reported by list_workflow_automation_skill_files. Use 'SKILL.md' for the main guide.
